title: Proportion Using the Unitary Method
introduction: Explore proportion using the unitary method using everyday examples.
definition: Find the value of one unit by dividing a total by its quantity. Multiply the unit value by the required quantity when the relationship is proportional.

examples.question: Five identical notebooks cost RM20. Cost of eight?

exercises.question: 3 pens cost RM9. Cost of one?
4 identical bags cost RM24. Cost of 7?
2 kg rice costs RM12. Cost of 5 kg?
6 bottles hold 12 L. Volume of one?
A pack of 5 costs RM15. Cost of 10?

summary: Find the value of one unit by dividing a total by its quantity. Multiply the unit value by the required quantity when the relationship is proportional.
